stanza: A rose by any other name
Fuck the mother in the green

q.line: Did I ever once turn my mind from the thought of revenge
stanza: It took me fifteen years to swallow all my tears
Among the urchins in the street
Until a priory took pity and hired me
To keep their vestry nice and neat
But never once in the employ of these holy men
Did I ever once turn my mind from the thought of revenge

partner.line: But never once in the employ of these holy men
